messages:
sophie: Quick heads-up — Atlas Analytics case study + AWS Marketplace listing just went live: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/B0XXXXX . Short highlights: integrated Redwood Dedicated via Marketplace Private Offer, 2-week onboarding, 3x inference throughput, ~40% unit cost reduction for their gen-AI pipelines. :tada:

own: Amazing news, congrats team! :confetti_ball: Do we have a one-paragraph customer quote we can use for social and the blog?

marketplace-bot: AWS Marketplace listing published (Listing ID: atlas-rlw-2026). Private Offer available — Offer ID: PO-987654.

marcus: Legal confirmed the PO and case study language yesterday, approved by compliance. We cleared data-sharing language with Atlas-CS.

alex: Can someone drop the final case study PDF and the short quote here? Marketing needs it for the press pack. Also pinging @marketing for amplification.

emma: Uploaded assets to Drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/partners/atlas-aws-case-study (PDF, 2 screenshots, 1 short clip). Suggested tweet: "Atlas Analytics scaled gen-AI inference 3x & cut unit costs 40% with Redwood Dedicated on AWS Marketplace — read the case study."

own: Can we get a console banner next week? cc @product — good moment to promote Marketplace integrations.

sophie: Timeline: Marketing press note Monday AM, social + blog Tuesday, console banner Wed. Marcus/legal to sign off on final press quote by EOD today. Owen — can you draft the tweet and a short LinkedIn post? Emma will post assets to the newsroom.

marketing-bot: Draft tweet saved: https://app.social/comp/34567. Assigned to owen (due: 2026-03-31).

marcus: Confirmed — I approved the exact quote: "Redwood made our production rollout predictable and 40% cheaper per inference, while reducing tail latency." Atlas gave permission to publish.

alex: Nice. Also, can support create a short tech blurb for our docs about Marketplace onboarding steps? A 3-4 bullet how-to would help customers replicate their setup.

emma: Yep — I'll coordinate with eng-docs. I'll also schedule a customer webinar next week with Atlas engineering to walk through the integration.

own: Huge win for the Marketplace strategy. Any early telemetry on inbound interest from Marketplace listing?

marketplace-bot: Day 1 metrics: 12 listing views, 3 private-offer inquiries submitted, 1 trial activation started. Will post daily digest in #partnerships.

sophie: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. If anyone needs to add or change the quote/assets, DM me. We'll post the public blog once marketing confirms final copy. :rocket:
